d: I went deep inside Cerro Rico, the infamous "Mountain That Eats Men" in Potosí, Bolivia. At over 4,000 meters above sea level, this active mine was once the source of the Spanish Empire's immense wealth, but it hides a dark and tragic history. I joined the local miners to witness what it is really like to work in these cramped, toxic tunnels where safety gear is scarce and the daily conditions are incredibly harsh. Deep underground, we also come face-to-face with "El Tío," the demonic spirit of the underworld, to whom miners offer coca leaves and cigarettes in exchange for protection.
